title: Nonexistence of blow-up solutions with smooth radiation for energy-critical equivariant wave maps
summary: We study $k$-equivariant energy critical wave maps $\mathbb{R}^{1+2} \to \mathbb{S}^2$, for any equivariance degree $k\ge 2$. We prove that the radiation associated with any finite-energy blow-up solution cannot satisfy a certain regularity condition; in particular, it cannot be smooth. The assumption $k \geq 2$ is necessary, since for $k = 1$ such solutions are known to exist. The starting point of our analysis is the soliton resolution theorem.
